cards.title: T-210
powers: {T210} deals 1 target 2 projectile damage. If this is the third power used this turn, increase that damage by 3.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One hero may use a power.
One player may draw a card.

cards.title: Double Tap
body: You may use 1 additional power during your power phase.

cards.title: Dual Strike
body: Up to 2 players, other than you, use 1 power now.

cards.title: Find the Shot
powers: Draw 1 card. Discard 1 card. You may use 1 power now.

cards.title: Call the Shot
powers: Discard 1 card. Another player may use 1 power now.

cards.title: Loadout: Knife
body: When this card enters play, use the power on it.
powers: {T210} deals 1 target 2 projectile damage. If this is the third power used this turn, you may destroy an ongoing card, equipment card, or non-character card damaged by this power. Destroy all of your other Loadout cards. For each Loadout card destroyed this way, use this power again.

cards.title: Loadout: Assault
body: When this card enters play, use the power on it.
powers: {T210} deals 1 target 3 fire damage. If this is the third power used this turn, {T210} deals up to 3 other targets 3 fire damage each. Destroy all of your other Loadout cards. For each Loadout card destroyed this way, use this power again.

cards.title: Loadout: Whisper
body: When this card enters play, use the power on it.
powers: {T210} deals up to 3 targets 1 irreducible projectile damage each. If this is the third power used this turn, draw 3 cards.

cards.title: Optimize Weaponry
body: You may use a power now.
If this power is printed on a Loadout card, {T210} deals 1 target 3 projectile damage.
Otherwise, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Optimize Awareness
body: You may use a power now.
If this power is printed on an Ongoing card, up to 3 players may draw a card.
Otherwise, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Optimize Frame
body: You may use a power now.
If this power is printed on your character card, {T210} regains 4 HP.
Otherwise, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Configuration: Flash Fire
body: At the end of your turn, T210 may deal 1 target X fire damage, where X = the number of powers used this turn.

cards.title: Configuration: Auto Attack
body: At the end of your turn, you may play a Loadout card.

cards.title: Configuration: Rapid Reboot
body: At the start of your turn, either {T210} gains 1 HP or move 1 Loadout card from your trash to your hand.

cards.title: Third Time's the Charm
body: Draw 3 cards.
Use the power printed on {T210} thrice.
{T210} deals themselves 3 psychic damage.
